reason: I'm two waiters down and the ones I have left would walk if I changed how the bill and tips work in the middle of service. My regulars know me, I know them, and I don't need an app to tell me who comes back or a loyalty stamp like a chain.
objection: Guests paying from a QR code means my waiters lose the moment at the table where the tip happens, and they'll fight it. And on top of 59 GEL there's a payment fee I can't see yet, so I don't know what it really costs me.
would_change_my_mind: Proof from another wine bar in Sololaki or Vake that tips went up or stayed the same with the QR payment, plus the exact per-transaction fee written down before I sign.
